# Trackr

> Trackr is a free personal finance and expense tracker built for the Philippines. It helps people log income and expenses, manage accounts, set savings goals, and get AI-powered insights on their spending — with no subscriptions, no ads, and no data selling.

Trackr is a web application built by Leyanne Mayo (https://leyannemayo.vercel.app). It requires a free account to use.

## Features

- Income and expense tracking: log transactions in seconds, categorized (Food, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Health, Entertainment, Salary, Freelance, Investment) and searchable
- Accounts: track balances across multiple accounts
- Goals: set savings goals and monitor progress
- Charts: visualize spending patterns and income vs. expenses
- AI Insights: AI-generated analysis and recommendations based on your monthly finances

## Pages

- [Home](https://trackrph.vercel.app/): landing page with feature overview
- [Login](https://trackrph.vercel.app/login): sign in to an existing account
- [Register](https://trackrph.vercel.app/register): create a free account

## Notes

- Free to use, no ads, no data selling
- Currency shown in Philippine Peso (PHP)
- The dashboard and finance data are private and require authentication
